What the rankings mean

Stars measure GitHub repository popularity, not quality. Priority is an editorial evaluation order within each category. Ratings are self-selected historical user feedback, not benchmarks or safety certification. Rating sorting currently uses SourceForge's original five-point scale only; missing data sorts last. Two sourced rating snapshots are available, not ratings for every tool. Dates are observation dates; indexed pages may lag live totals. We never combine incompatible providers or scales.
